title: Daily Conversation
description: Casual everyday English with a friendly neighbor or peer. Practice talking about hobbies, weekend plans, and daily routines.
starter_prompt: Hi there! It's so nice to meet you. What do you usually like to do in your free time?

title: Job Interview
description: Drill common interview questions with an empathetic hiring manager. Practice structuring concise, confident professional answers.
starter_prompt: Hello! Welcome to our interview today. To start off, could you please tell me a little bit about yourself?

title: College Conversation
description: Navigate life on campus. Practice speaking with classmates about projects, exams, professors, and student clubs.
starter_prompt: Hey! Are you also taking the computer science seminar this semester? How are you finding the coursework so far?

title: Travel & Exploration
description: Essential English for exploring the world: asking for directions, ordering food, checking into hotels, and airport transit.
starter_prompt: Good day! Welcome to the Central Metro station info kiosk. Where can I help you travel today?

title: Confident Introduction
description: Master your 60-second self-introduction for meetups, networking events, or meeting new international friends.
starter_prompt: Hi! Welcome to our language exchange meetup. How would you introduce yourself to someone you just met?
